tutors.name: Ahmed Mohamed
tutors.title: English & Islamic English Tutor
tutors.summary: I am an English tutor with five years of experience helping children, teenagers, and adults improve their English communication skills. I focus on practical speaking, vocabulary, and confidence-building activities. I also enjoy teaching English through Islamic topics and everyday situations.

tutors.name: Mohamed Ahmed Hassan
tutors.title: Qur'an and Islamic Studies Teacher
tutors.summary: I am an experienced Qur’an and Islamic Studies teacher with over two years of experience teaching non-Arabic-speaking Muslims in English. I have worked with several well-established academies, including Makkah Academy, Super Muslim Academy, Ruwaq Al-Quran Academy, Bedaya Academy, and Noor Al-Quran Academy, in addition to providing private lessons. I specialize in teaching Qur’an, Tajweed, Tafsir, and Islamic Studies. My lessons are engaging, structured, and tailored to each student’s level, helping them learn confidently while developing a strong connection with their faith.
